text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our next race is the Japan Dirt Derby at
Oi
Racecourse, a G1 dirt race exclusive
to
classic-year runners.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The most notable thing about it is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, Trainer. Night races are
incredible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Dirt Derby is a night race. It's
also the only G1 dirt race limited to
classic-year racers,
and it's held right in
the middle of the summer to boot, so
the heat is no joke.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It can easily overwhelm an Umamusume
who takes
it on feeling less than steady.
And yet, all the
same...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can lose. Not after all
the
training we've done.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I've managed to do all the training you
prepared
especially for me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
All I need now is the finishing touches.
Can I ask you to lay the usual on me?
Put your back into it too! Give these
shoulders a massage rough enough to
blow the stars out of the sky!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I pack assurance into every thump of my
shoulder massage. It's an exchange of
feelings and passion
only possible
between the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're done hesitating. Today, Wonder
Acute and
I take on this challenge as
one.

Hehehe. It appears today is graduation
day.
Indeed...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Today, the Overlord descends from her
throne to bear witness to your night
performance! Show me what kind of duet
the two of you have become
capable of.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If the two of you remain out of sync, you
cannot hope to achieve a pleasing
performance. However, if you can
communicate your true
feelings...
